build_ObbTracker: build a python module using ObbTracker to track oriented bounding boxes across frames with Hungarian matching
create_nms_3d: create a function that runs 3D NMS on oriented bounding boxes suppressing duplicates by IoU threshold
create_nms_2d: create a function that runs 2D NMS on oriented bounding boxes using 2D IoU and semantic class matching
review_ObbTracker_track: review the ObbTracker track method to understand how it associates new detections with existing scene objects
refactor_ObbTracker_add_new_obbs: refactor the ObbTracker add_new_obbs method to customize how new tracked objects are instantiated and weighted
